title: The Passenger — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “The Passenger”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Introduction: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | C | E (repeat 1×)
Verse 1: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | C | E (repeat 2×)
Refrain 1: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | C | E (repeat 1×)
Verse 2: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | C | E (repeat 2×)
Refrain 2: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | C | E (repeat 1×)
Bridge: Am | F | Am | F | C | E | C | E (repeat 1×)
Final refrain: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | C | E (repeat 1×)
Outro: Am | F | C | E (repeat 1×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Muted beats and dry off-beat chord attacks; alternation of G and E at the cycle ending.
Score section map: Introduction (1–8) · Verse 1 (9–24) · Refrain 1 (25–32) · Verse 2 (33–48) · Refrain 2 (49–56) · Bridge (57–64) · Final refrain (65–72) · Outro (73–76).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://uketunes.wordpress.com/2019/01/20/the-passenger-iggy-pop/
